Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Ananya - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Anita - 36 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Savitri - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Ananya and Anita stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Ananya, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh folds his hands and prays.]

Ananya: "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh lights a diya.]

Rishabh: "Oh wow!"

[Ananya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Ananya (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh paints a picture.]

Rishabh: "Really?"

[Rishabh draws a picture of the house.]

Rishabh: "Ananya, look at this."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Anita and Savitri stand near him.]

Anita: "Mother, look over here."

[Rishabh lies down on the sofa.]

Savitri: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh sits down on a chair.]

Rishabh (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh flops down on the sofa.]

Rishabh (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Savitri (gently): "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The garden - Day

[Rishabh stands in the garden. Anita and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh waters the plants.]

Anita: "Careful!"

[Rishabh chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Anita: "That was such a fun day!"
